children: Australia's central bank will debate the case for a rate hike at its policy meeting this month, a senior official said on Tuesday.

In an interview with the Australian Broadcasting Corporation, Andrew Hauser, Deputy Governor of Reserve Bank of Australia, said the key question facing policymakers was if three rate hikes this year were enough to tame inflation, or if more needed to be done.
